target_customer: Developers and teams using AI coding assistants
problem: Prompts behind AI generated code are lost, so teammates cannot see or continue AI conversations.
business_model: Open source extension with planned team analytics (not stated)
product_category: Developer tools for AI coding collaboration

technical_complexity.rationale: A VS Code and Cursor extension that stores chats in a folder is modest engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Open source and easily absorbed by editors such as Cursor.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found; editors could add history sharing.

market_need_then: No demand evidence beyond launch post and Product Hunt listing.

branding.domain_note: getgait.com (prefix get); the host did not resolve at research time.

brand_strength.rationale: Name shares a word with gait analysis products and no brand press was found.

outcome_analysis: Gait was a two founder open source extension for sharing AI coding prompts. It took a $500K pre-seed from YC and is listed inactive with no shutdown notice or cause found, so the cause is not public. The incumbent_copied factor is a weak inference since editors can add the feature.
notes: Funding rests on one database (VCBacked). getgait.com did not resolve in this environment so the site is treated as unreachable. Competitor search returned only undated Product Hunt tools, list empty. Failure factor is inference.
